title: panicum oligosanthes var. helleri
intro: Panicum oligosanthes var. helleri, commonly known as Hella's panic grass or elephant grass, is a plant species native to Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hella's panic grass are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
